extDescription.message: Zen-inspired touches for Firefox: copy the tab URL with a shortcut (with a quick confirmation) and preview links in a Glance overlay.

blockedTitle.message: This site can't be previewed here

blockedText.message: The site refused to open inside the preview, or it could not be reached. You can open the link in a new tab instead.

optModifier.message: Glance trigger (modifier + click on a link)

optShortcutHint.message: To change the copy shortcut: about:addons, gear icon, Manage Extension Shortcuts.

optBackCloses.message: Alt+Left closes new tabs and Glance (mouse Back button, if mapped to Alt+Left)

playerEmptyHint.message: Audio and video from your tabs will show up here.

playerClose.message: Stop and hide (it returns when it plays again)

optMediaEnabled.message: Players sidebar: track media playing in tabs

blockedCspText.message: Its security policy (CSP) stops other sites from opening inside it. Open the link in a new tab instead.

optSessionAccess.message: Share my sign-in with Glance previews (experimental)

optSessionAccessHint.message: Firefox keeps a site's cookies apart when it is shown inside another site, so previews can look signed out. Click inside a preview and Firefox may ask to let the site use its cookies; if you allow it, the preview reloads signed in.

optShowReleaseNotes.message: Show what's new after an update

playersCloseAllHint.message: Hide every paused player (each one returns when it plays again)
